title: DecArena: Evaluating Large-Scale Decentralized Multi-Agent Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2611.15521v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Emerging personal AI agents raise fundamental scalability and privacy concerns for centralized multi-agent systems (MASs), which rely on a global orchestrator with broad access to agents, resources, and communication. In decentralized environments, global visibility is unavailable. Agents need to proactively discover non-local resources (e.g. tools, skills), and collaborate with other agents to solve tasks. We study decentralized multi-agent collaboration under graph-constrained communication, a natural reflection of human structures. Each agent observes only its local state and can interact only with neighboring agents. We introduce a benchmark with synthetic scalable distributed tool calling with 100K+ tools. Our experiments reveal that recent LLM agents struggle to discover non-local relevant resources and collaborate in decentralized setting. translated_title: DecArena：评估大规模去中心化多智能体协作
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.15521v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：新兴的个人AI智能体给集中式多智能体系统（MAS）带来了根本性的可扩展性和隐私问题，这类系统依赖于对智能体、资源和通信拥有广泛访问权限的全局协调器。在去中心化环境中，全局可见性无法获得。智能体需要主动发现非本地资源（例如工具、技能），并与其他智能体协作来完成任务。我们研究了图约束通信下的去中心化多智能体协作，这是对人类社会结构的一种自然反映。每个智能体只能观察其本地状态，并且只能与相邻的智能体交互。我们引入了一个包含10万以上工具的合成可扩展分布式工具调用基准测试。我们的实验表明，最新的LLM智能体难以在去中心化环境中发现非本地相关资源并展开协作。此外，标准强化学习也无法可靠地克服这一局限。
tldr: 该论文提出了DecArena基准——一个在图约束通信下、包含10万以上工具的大规模去中心化多智能体协作评测平台，实验揭示当前LLM智能体难以发现非本地资源并进行协作，且标准强化学习无法可靠地解决这一局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DecArena, a benchmark for large-scale decentralized multi-agent collaboration under graph-constrained communication featuring 100K+ tools, revealing that current LLM agents struggle to discover non-local resources and collaborate, and that standard reinforcement learning fails to reliably overcome this limitation.
